description: This file contains the implementation of an API endpoint class 'AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPI' that handles HTTP GET requests to check for punch-in record overlaps when editing attendance records within the OrangeHRM plugin system. It includes methods for request parameter validation, time calculation, and overlap checking logic.

classes.name: AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class handling GET requests to check for punch-in record overlap when editing attendance entries. Implements validation, time calculations, and overlap logic.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to determine if the punch-in record overlaps with existing records during editing, by validating input and comparing UTC times.

methods.name: getUTCTimeByOffsetAndDateTime
methods.description: Computes UTC DateTime objects for punch-in and punch-out times based on input date, time, and timezone offsets.
